title: When creating a HID report item, only set isRange to true if usageMinimum and usageMaximum are both set
body:
Under the ["To create a HID report item"](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-creating-a-hid-report-item) section, steps 28-30 are:
> 28. If "[usageMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usageminimum)" is in localState, then set reportItem["[usageMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usageminimum)"] to localState["[usageMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usageminimum)"].
> 29. If "[usageMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usagemaximum)" is in localState, then set reportItem["[usageMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usagemaximum)"] to localState["[usageMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usagemaximum)"].
> 30. Set reportItem["[isRange](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-isrange)"] to true if reportItem["[usageMinimum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usageminimum)"] is less than reportItem["[usageMaximum](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usagemaximum)"], or false otherwise.

If I'm reading this right, this seems to allow setting `reportItem["isRange"]` even only one of `localState["usageMinimum"]` and `localState["usageMaximum"]` is set. (the other will default to 0) Additionally, if `localState["usageMinimum"]` and `localState["usageMaximum"]` are both set to equal values, then this will leave `reportItem["isRange"]` false, which feels wrong.

To fix both of these issues, I'd recommend changing these steps to something like:

28. Set `reportItem["isRange"]` to true if both "usageMinimum" and "usageMaximum" are in `localState` and `localState["usageMinimum"]` is less than or equal to `localState["usageMaximum"]`, or false otherwise.
29. If `reportItem["isRange"]` is true, set `reportItem["usageMinimum"]` to `localState["usageMinimum"]`.
30. If `reportItem["isRange"]` is true, set `reportItem["usageMaximum"]` to `localState["usageMaximum"]`.
